text:
This week, ROBI handled a total of 297 orders with an average fetch time of 61 seconds, which included robot work at 54 seconds. The busiest day was May 15th when all 297 orders were processed successfully. Despite the high volume, there were still some slowest orders like #1800 for a pen that took over two and a half hours to fetch. ROBI encountered various types of failures including item_not_found (1), [[reachability]]_failed (63), unknown (80), no_valid_depth (46), [[handover]]_failed (46), and search_exhausted (60). These issues required 96 orders needing retries, totaling 192 attempts. Additionally, ROBI issued collision warnings on 960 occasions this week.

Notable patterns included frequent failures related to item_not_found and reachability problems, which often led to [[retry]]ing the order or finding alternative solutions. The high number of collisions highlights areas where adjustments might be needed for smoother operation.
